headline: Special places
title: 4 Evolutions That Need a Special Place | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Four Aniimo only evolve in the right spot. Pranky becomes Leafy on the giant lotus leaf where the Alpha Leafy lives. Hummin becomes Tuckin after digging in for twenty seconds at the entrance of Sanctum Twisted Roots. Bolty becomes Blazen under the Blitz Tree in the Blitzwood. And Lavazar needs a hot spring soak to become Magmarex. Which one took you longest? Comment below!
description: Location evolutions in Aniimo: Leafy (giant lotus leaf), Tuckin (dig in at Sanctum: Twisted Roots), Blazen (Blitz Tree in the Blitzwood), Magmarex (hot spring).
